text:
maria: Quick sync: product wants a concise SLA + policy catalog we can point customers to. Sales is asking for one-page guidance: what "isolation" means (tech and SLA delta) and a default migration path.

tony: Can we define 3 isolation modes with clear cost multipliers? e.g. shared-hosted (baseline), soft-slices (+x%), dedicated-pools (+y%). We need the numbers for pricing and contract templates.

kevin: Proposal: mode names = shared, tenant-slice, tenant-island. Shared: no SLA changes. tenant-slice: vCPU/GPU reservation per-tenant, SLA 99.9% p95 latency guard. tenant-island: physical isolation, 99.95% uptime and separate audit streams.

eldra: Ops concerns: tenant-slice still risks noisy neighbors on network egress. Need throttles and per-tenant circuit breakers. Also telemetry must include route decision lineage for audits.

maria: Good - include explicit failover semantics: for tenant-slice we allow cross-region fallback on overload; for tenant-island fallback should be opt-in (customer signoff).

tony: Sales feedback: customers ask for 'SLA matrix' table with columns: uptime, p95 latency, failover policy, residency guarantee, audit retention, encryption key ownership.

kevin: I sketched a matrix in the RFC draft. Example row: `tenant-island | 99.95% | p95 <120ms | no automatic fallback | EU-only residency | 3y audit-retention | KMS customer-managed`.

eldra: We should add launch gates: perf cert (synthetic + customer workload), chaos tests (simulate region loss), billing precision (per-minute metering), and runbook with escalation matrix.

maria: Timeline ask: product planning needs a prioritized MVP for next quarter. My recommendation: unblock tenant-slice first (gets most customers onboard with moderate infra work). tenant-island is Q3+ effort.

tony: Agree. MVP scope for tenant-slice: routing-DSL update (route by tenant->slice), quota shaping, tenant-specific autoscaling knobs, per-tenant telemetry tag, billing tag. Blockers: scheduler support for reservations and cross-az placement.

kevin: Infra estimate: routing DSL + policy engine ~4w, scheduler changes + reservation APIs ~6w, telemetry/lineage ~3w, billing changes ~2w. End-to-end ~12w assuming no unexpected infra debt.

maria: Risk note: if we under-provision slice reservations, perf regressions create churn. Need conservative sizing and canary with 2 pilot tenants.

sales-bot: crm-bot: created opportunity note "FinAnalytics pilot - interested in tenant-slice" link: https://crm.redwood/opps/FA-221

infra-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket RB-4100 "isolation-modes: SLA matrix + tenant-slice MVP" assigned kevin. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/RB-4100

eldra: Small tech detail: routing decisions must be idempotent and stable across retries. Add request-id propagation and route-decision hash to logs.

kevin: ack. Also recommending an opt-in telemetry header X-Redwood-Trace-Policy for customers that want detailed lineage during canary.

maria: Action items: Kevin -> convert RFC to a proto-spec with matrix + cost multipliers; Tony -> get pricing deltas from finance; Eldra -> list scheduler constraints and chaos test plan; I'll coordinate canary customers and prepare the product one-pager.

tony: I'll loop in finance & solutions to get ballpark delta numbers by EOD Fri.

kevin: I'll post the proto-spec in product/rfc/isolation-modes and ping here when ready.

maria: Decision: we target tenant-slice MVP for next quarter with two pilots, gate is perf cert + billing integration. If that passes we start tenant-island design work.

eldra: +1 from ops. :thumbsup:
